subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept replacing fs.glob with this custom yielding bootstrap-extra-files walker for the embedded_run bootstrap-context stall fix?
rationale: The patch appears correct and keeps public SDK signatures stable, but the walker owns upgrade-visible glob parity for existing operator configs and unit tests cannot cover every workspace shape.

options.title: Accept After Current-Head Gates
options.body: Land after rebase/current-head CI if maintainers accept the parity tests and loader proof as sufficient compatibility evidence.

options.title: Require Live Embedded-Run Proof
options.body: Ask for one connected embedded_run proof showing channel or WebSocket I/O continues while a large bootstrap-extra-files scan runs.

options.title: Pause For A Different Scheduler Design
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers do not want core workspace bootstrap to own a custom glob walker.

recommendation.title: Accept After Current-Head Gates
recommendation.body: Land after rebase/current-head CI if maintainers accept the parity tests and loader proof as sufficient compatibility evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across bootstrap reads, hook contracts, and compatibility-sensitive runtime architecture in the touched surfaces.
